It happened that China had lured and executed the traitorous eunuch Xining, losing his spy network; Togtoh Buqa and Alazhizhi again sent envoys to make peace with the court, all withdrawing their forces; Esen also resolved to cease fighting.

In the twenty-third year of Chenghua the Yanghan King plotted a border raid, and the Hami ruler Hanshen reported it.
哈密罕慎: 罕慎 (Hanshen) is the personal name of the Hami ruler; "Shen" truncates it.
In the twenty-third year of Chenghua, the Yanghan King plotted to invade the border; the Hami ruler Shen came to report it.
In the twenty-third year of Chenghua, the Yanghan King plotted to invade the border; the Hami ruler Hanshen came to report it.
罕慎 (Hanshen) is the personal name of the Hami ruler.

The idiomatic line drops the verb, running the name into the office title.

Esen followed; Doyan and Taining could not hold out and begged to surrender; Fuyu alone fled to avoid the Naowen River; the three guards declined further.
Esen followed; Doyan and Taining could not hold out and begged to surrender; Fuyu alone fled to the Naowen River to escape; the three guards declined further.
走避腦溫江 means fled to take refuge at the Naowen River, not avoiding the river.
Esen followed. Doyan and Taining could not hold out and surrendered. Fuyu alone fled beyond the Naowen River. The three guards grew weaker still.
Esen followed. Doyan and Taining could not hold out and surrendered. Fuyu alone fled to the Naowen River for refuge. The three guards grew weaker still.
走避腦溫江: fled to the Naowen River to take refuge; "beyond" is not in the text.
In the thirteenth year the emperor on tour reached Daxifeng Pass, planning to summon the three-guard chiefs below the pass for a feast, but the plan failed.
In the thirteenth year the emperor on tour reached Daxifeng Pass, intending to campaign against the three-guard chiefs by summoning them all below the pass for a feast, but the plan failed.
將征三衛頭目 (intending to campaign against the chiefs) is omitted.
Governor-General Yang Xuanjiang, planning to restrain Xin'ai, detained Tonghan and required his sons to serve as hostages in rotation.
Governor-General Yang Xuan, planning to restrain Xin'ai, detained Tonghan and required his sons to serve as hostages in rotation.
總督楊選將為牽制辛愛計: the name is 楊選 (Yang Xuan); 將 means "intending to". s0248 confirms with 選得罪.
Governor-General Yang Xuanjiang, intending a plan to restrain Xin'ai, detained Tonghan and ordered his sons to take turns as hostages.
Governor-General Yang Xuan, intending a plan to restrain Xin'ai, detained Tonghan and ordered his sons to take turns as hostages.
The name is 楊選 (Yang Xuan); 將 means "intending to".
